name: redpact
description: Develop with local Redpact-managed Integration, Unit and Playwright execution evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Develop in worktrees with reviewable evidence.
interface.longDescription: Use redpact-init for project setup. Redpact routes Integration through MCP run_tests, Playwright through declared UI/API targets, and Unit through the configured UI/API command; direct Docker or shell runs are local-only, not connected evidence. User-visible UI changes also record desktop and mobile Playwright captures for human review; captures do not replace functional assertions or imply agent visual approval. Feature work uses an isolated worktree; redpact current stays in the supplied checkout. Completion requires observed evidence for changed acceptance outcomes; missing required Integration or browser evidence cannot be replaced by Unit success.
defaultPrompt: Use $redpact to implement and test this feature.
Use $redpact current to develop this feature on the current checkout branch.
